title: THURSDAY INTERVALS
subtitle: THURSDAY. INTERVALS. OPEN UP, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN SHORT SHARP STATIONS. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE TOMORROW.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. THURSDAY. INTERVALS. FIFTEEN MINUTES. OPEN UP, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN SHORT SHARP STATIONS. DO NOT HIDE BEHIND THAT KEYBOARD, YOU LAZY SOD.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. THURSDAY INTERVALS DONE. HEART HONEST. LEGS HONEST. NOW GET BACK TO WORK WITHOUT SITTING LIKE A BLOODY FOLDED DECKCHAIR.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: SCAPULAR ROW
exercises.cue: STAND TALL OR HINGE LIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN SLOW. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH AND POSTURE OPENER. NO YANKING.
exercises.speakStart: SCAPULAR ROWS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. OPEN THE BACK AFTER THAT DESK. DO NOT YANK LIKE YOU ARE STARTING A LAWNMOWER.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE SHOULDERS LOOSE.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: STEP BACK. FRONT KNEE TRACKS THE TOE. CHEST UP. LIGHT HAND ON A CHAIR IF YOU NEED IT. OWN THE BALANCE.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO SETS. SIX EACH LEG. STEP BACK. CHEST UP. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT WOBBLE ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY WEATHERVANE.

exercises.name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS
exercises.cue: HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS. DRIVE THE KNEES IN SHORT AND CLEAN. STEADY PACE. THIS IS YOUR INTERVAL CARDIO. NO FLOPPY HIPS.
exercises.speakStart: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. TWO ROUNDS. TWENTY SECONDS. HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS. DRIVE THE KNEES IN CLEAN. STEADY PACE. THIS IS YOUR INTERVAL WORK. DO NOT FLOP ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY SEAL ON A ROCK.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. CATCH YOUR BREATH. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: STEP-UP
exercises.cue: USE A STURDY STAIR OR LOW STEP. DRIVE THROUGH THE HEEL. STAND TALL AT THE TOP. CONTROL THE LOWER. SWITCH LEGS CLEAN.
exercises.speakStart: STEP UPS. TWO SETS. EIGHT EACH LEG. DRIVE THROUGH THE HEEL. STAND TALL. CONTROL THE LOWER. THIS IS YOUR LEG INTERVAL. DO NOT STOMP LIKE YOU ARE CRUSHING GRAPES FOR A BLOODY WEDDING.

exercises.name: INCLINE PUSH-UP
exercises.cue: FIFTH STAIR. HANDS ON THE FIFTH STEP. BODY STRAIGHT. CHEST TO THE EDGE. FULL LOCKOUT. THIS IS YOUR PUSH INTERVAL. DO NOT DROP THE STEP.
exercises.speakStart: INCLINE PUSH UPS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. FIFTH STAIR. BODY STRAIGHT. CHEST TO THE EDGE. FULL LOCKOUT. DO NOT SAG LIKE A BLOODY HAMMOCK.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. SHAKE THE ARMS. I'M WATCHING.

exercises.name: SIDE PLANK
exercises.cue: ON YOUR SIDE. FOREARM UNDER THE SHOULDER. HIPS UP. KNEE DOWN IS LEGAL. HOLD ABOUT FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. SHORT AND HONEST. BUILD TOWARD LONGER LATER.
exercises.speakStart: SIDE PLANKS. TWO ROUNDS. FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. KNEE DOWN IS FINE. HIPS UP. SHORT HOLDS. WE BUILD TOWARD TWENTY LATER. DO NOT COLLAPSE LIKE A BLOODY DECKCHAIR.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. SWITCH SIDES CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
exercises.speakDone: SIDE PLANKS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
